versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-douyin-vault.

- Provides a command-line tool for querying Douyin public data (keywords, creators, videos, hot topics, comments).
- Natural language intent automatically mapped to commands, no technical terms required.
- Limits: 10,000 records per run, public info only, Douyin-only.
- Strict token management: outputs neutral errors for invalid tokens, no contact/marketing info at runtime.
- Outputs pure JSON; logs saved to logs/; error and parameter handling as documented.
